title: Knowledge Injected Prompt Based Fine-tuning for Multi-label Few-shot ICD Coding
reasoning: The paper focuses on automatic ICD coding, specifically improving performance on multi-label few-shot classification using knowledge injection and prompt-based fine-tuning.
